_comment: NPC-given generated mission dungeons (Knubot {givedungeon HASH}). Each is a terminal-style generated quest with a mission key and a seeded, no-respawn ACG dungeon behind the MissionEntrance EntranceInstance; it ends (and sends everyone out) when the objective NPC dies, or expires after LifetimeSeconds. One floor of Style, FloorSize rolled from the seed between Min and Max. The objective NPC stands in the deepest room with 4+ spawn points, the boss on another point of that room; Population fills the other rooms (SpawnPointChancePercent per district spawn point, at least one NPC per room) at level Quality. Generated by hand 2026-10-18 for Karli Cappelleri's crashed alien ship on Arete (8009); layout modelled on AO-Universe 'Place the Bomb' (scout ship interior, Brigadier General with an add on the flight deck). Rates and sizes guessed.

Dungeons.Title: The Alien Ship
Dungeons.Summary: Karli Cappelleri wants the Zix inside the crashed alien ship dead. It hides in the Alien General's room, deep inside the ship. Use your mission key at the Crashed Alien Ship door.

Dungeons.Title: The Alien Ship (Team)
Dungeons.Summary: Karli Cappelleri wants the Alien General dead. Fight down three decks of the crashed ship with your team and take the lift to the General's arena. Teammates walk in through the Crashed Alien Ship door with you; only the leader of the mission needs the key.
